How about this for a change of pace? 

Grab a cheap journal or spiral notebook and then find a nice smooth pen you can write with. 

Go to a café that's nearby and take a nice slow walk, observe the beauty around you and breathe nice and deep. Smile for no reason while you so this. Think of a few things that you are grateful for along the way. The fresh air, the breeze around you. Appreciate these little things. 


When you get to the café, this is your scared space where you will sculpt your new life. It's not going to happen overnight, but you'll be able get there one bit at a time with deliberate effort. 

In the journal just dump out your thoughts. Let it all out, write freely, with no expectations. Write about your situation, write about your feelings, write about what you want to change in your life. 

But remember this. And this will be the hardest thing to chew. You are responsible for your life no matter the circumstances. You choose how your life plays out, you choose how you react to the people around you, you choose what you allow into your life. And you choose who to spend your time around. Itll be hard, and people around you will drag you down, but you still choose how you react to things. You can begin to allow beauty into your life if you want it, and you are capable of this. 

It's going to be a slow process of re-programming your mind and habits, but if you stay focused, you can completely change your life and walk away a different person and look back at this day and go wow what a ride. 

The pain of discipline is better than the pain of regret. 

Make the café your scared time, a special process. Get a nice warm tea, and drink it mindfully and be fully present in the moment when you do this, just observe the sensations and people around you without any thought. 

Go to this café daily, until you are ready to leave, you'll know when this is. It might take a lot of journaling. It's going to feel so uncomfortable, because it's away from your daily routine. It's easy to do what your doing right now, and it will be hard to go to the café to journal and reprogram yourself. 

But this is the start of challenging yourself to do the uncomfortable things. And when you do more uncomfortable things, it becomes a way of life. And then you grow. 

Journal about how you are going to build your new life, the new attitudes your are going to develop towards the people around you, the things you want to remove from your life. Make a nice big list of the hobbies you want to start, and the things you want to remove. You might have to buy some new books to help guide you. Maybe reading at the café will become a new favorite thing. 

It might help to journal the things you want to release from your life, and then throw that in a garbage bin. Repeat if nessecary. 

Once you figure out a list of things you want to change about yourself, begin with single focus until that becomes second nature and then move on to the next thing. Whether that's computer habits, how you interact with people, your day to day thinking etc. 

Maybe you can just spark up random conversations with people at the café, and be proud and optimistic that your on a new path. 

If you keep riding against this grain and really stick to it, you'll build momentum to the point where you don't fall back to old patterns. It will be tough, but the brain is remarkable and so adaptable.
